claims: The 2026 Masters projected cut line is 4-over par (+4) as of Friday afternoon, according to DataGolf projections.
The 2026 Masters field is cut to the top 50 players and ties.
The 2026 Masters cut moved to +4 on Friday.
Bryson DeChambeau faced the potential of missing the cut at +4 or higher in the 2026 Masters.
The Masters takes the lowest 50 scores and ties.
The Masters rule change to taking the lowest 50 scores and ties took effect in 2020.
This information is based on data as of April 10, 2026.
